name: Trial interventions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN t.nct_id, i.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial adverse events (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN t.nct_id, ae.term LIMIT 10

name: Trial sites (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) RETURN t.nct_id, s.name, s.country LIMIT 10

name: Trial outcomes (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:MEASURES]->(o:Outcome) RETURN t.nct_id, o.title LIMIT 10

name: Trial sponsors (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN t.nct_id, sp.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial conditions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) RETURN t.nct_id, cond.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial arm groups
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_ARM]->(arm:ArmGroup) RETURN t.nct_id, arm.title LIMIT 10

name: Trials per country
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) RETURN s.country, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most common interventions
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN i.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most common adverse events
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most studied conditions
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) RETURN cond.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Top sponsors
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN sp.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Interventions for cancer trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN i.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Adverse events for diabetes trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Sites running the most trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) WHERE s.country = 'United States' RETURN s.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Condition → Intervention → AE chain
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Hypertension' WITH t, i MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN i.name, ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Sponsors funding cancer research
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' MATCH (t)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN sp.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: MeSH coded trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CODED_AS_MESH]->(m:MeSHDescriptor) RETURN t.nct_id, m.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial publications
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(pub:Publication) RETURN t.nct_id, pub.citation LIMIT 10

name: Multi-arm trials with adverse events
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_ARM]->(arm:ArmGroup) WITH t, count(arm) AS arms WHERE arms >= 3 MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN t.nct_id, arms, ae.term LIMIT 10
